Good morning everyone.
Here is the plan for the concert weekend.
On Friday we load the van at 9 in the morning and leave Zagreb by 10. The drive to Split takes about 4 hours, so we should arrive around 2 in the afternoon. The sound check starts at 5, and the doors open at 8. We have 12 songs in the first set and 9 in the second set.
Please check your instruments tonight: new strings, spare batteries and the in-ear monitors.
The hotel is booked for 2 nights, and breakfast is from 7 to 10.
On Saturday morning we record a short video for the festival, so wear something simple and bright. Marija will bring the camera and two lights.
On Sunday we drive back after lunch.
If anything changes, I will send a message to the group.
Thank you, and see you on Friday.

Hi Tom,
The rehearsal moves to Thursday, the 14th, at 7:30 in the evening.
Please bring the two frame drums, the long cables and 3 microphones.
The studio costs 45 euros per hour, so let's finish by ten.
Thank you.
